basic_details.job_title: IRMA ISEED Programme Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: IRMA ISEED Foundation, a Section 8 not-for-profit company and not a government body, is hiring a Programme Assistant at its headquarters in Anand, Gujarat. The post is purely on contract for one year, with a three-month probation period primarily, and carries a consolidated remuneration of INR 30,000-35,000/- per month. The essential qualification is a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Social Sciences, Agriculture and allied or related fields. Applications are online at irma.ac.in and close at 23:59 on 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About IRMA ISEED
content_sections.text: The Incubator for Social Enterprises and Entrepreneurs for Development (ISEED) at IRMA started in August 2016. It supports and nurtures early-stage rural, social and collective enterprises. In October 2021 it was incorporated as a Section 8 Not-for-Profit under the Companies Act 2013, supporting social enterprises and collectives through capacity building, funding, Go-to-Market and Go-to-Technology support.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Social Sciences, Agriculture and allied or related fields. A Master's degree is preferred. Previous experience in program management, preferably in the field of incubation or administration-related work, value chain study or similar domains. Experience in incubation and acceleration centre(s) setup will be an added advantage. Candidates with relevant experience may be given preference. Strong communication (oral and written) and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and build relationships with diverse stakeholders, are a must. Excellent organisational and time management abilities, with a keen attention to detail. Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite and project management tools. The applicant should preferably be under 30 years of age at the time of application. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for any discipline-specific eligibility requirements.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is INR 30,000-35,000/- per month. No additional allowance or facilities will be provided. The position is purely on a contract basis for one year, with a three-month probation period primarily. The tenure may be extended based on satisfactory performance, subject to approval by the competent authority. It is a full-time position based at the IRMA ISEED Foundation headquarters in Anand, Gujarat. The Programme Assistant reports directly to the CEO & MD, IRMA ISEED Foundation, and occasional travel may be required for program-related events and activities.

content_sections.heading: IRMA ISEED Programme Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Assisting and coordinating ongoing projects and activities of the IRMA ISEED Foundation. Coordinating with the various departments of IRMA and TSU for smooth functioning of the Centre and maintenance of the incubation centre. Assistance in programme documentation and reporting on a regular basis. Managing the day-to-day activities of the IRMA ISEED Foundation. Managing communication for ISEED's programs and collaborations on digital media platforms and offline platforms. Assisting in the development and execution of program strategies and initiatives to support social entrepreneurs. Assisting in coordination of project activities, timelines, and deliverables to ensure smooth project execution. Support in the preparation of project reports, presentations, and documentation for internal and external stakeholders. Coordinate program activities, including workshops, boot camps, capacity-building programs, and networking events, ensuring smooth execution and participant engagement. Assist in the identification, evaluation, and selection of potential enterprise ventures for incubation. Conduct research, gather data, and analyse information to provide valuable insights and recommendations for project improvement. Assist in monitoring program progress, provide regular updates to and support in Business Development to the Programme Manager. Any other work/responsibility as assigned or decided by the reporting authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IRMA ISEED Programme Assistant
content_sections.text: Go to the IRMA careers page at https://irma.ac.in/careers/careers.php , where the notice asks interested applicants to apply online. Submit the online application by 23:59 on 23 November 2026, the last date given in the notice. The notice does not name any documents to upload or any form-filling steps.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only short-listed candidates will be called for the interview. The Foundation reserves the right to change or apply appropriate shortlisting criteria in case of a large number of applications. Mere fulfilment of the minimum qualifications and experience prescribed will not make an applicant eligible to be called for an interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No correspondence, interim enquiries or telephonic enquiries in the matter will be entertained. ISEED states that it is committed to equal opportunities and inclusion of all social groups, including people belonging to minority groups, Gender, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, and persons with disabilities.
